## OWNER SCOPE UPDATE — 2026-11-06 — DEFER BOTH USB MIDI AND BLE MIDI FROM THE CURRENT AQUORA RELEASE

**This supersedes the prior owner update saying that USB MIDI remained mandatory.** The owner now explicitly authorizes deferring **USB MIDI as well as Bluetooth/BLE MIDI** from AQUORA's current next-version/v0.6.6 release. Both may be revisited after **KIRA-9 has a good working firmware build**, subject to a new owner priority decision.

**Current release disposition:**
- `MIDI-USB`: **OWNER-AUTHORIZED DEFERRED / NOT CURRENT RELEASE BLOCKER**. Class-compliant USB IN/OUT, clock/transport/notes/CC, disconnect/recovery, iPad hub interoperability and external USB clock tests are deferred. Do **not** confuse firmware update SysEx with completed class-compliant MIDI.
- `MIDI-BLE`: **OWNER-AUTHORIZED DEFERRED / NOT CURRENT RELEASE BLOCKER**. BLE discovery, GATT, clock/transport, pairing, radio handover and wireless interoperability tests are deferred.
- Preserve any already written generic/partial MIDI code at a verified checkpoint, without destabilizing, publishing, advertising or enabling unverified features in the current firmware. A clean, explicit 'unavailable/not enabled' status is better than misleading connection UI.
- **AIR remains required and functional**. Deferred MIDI adapters must not seize radio/USB resources or interfere with AIR, audio, controls, upgrade/rollback or playback.
- **PLAY-button LED tempo blink remains required based on AQUORA's internal musical clock**. Its external MIDI clock sync portion is deferred with MIDI, and must not block the current release.
- Continue ALL other active AQUORA scope (#1 LEDs, #8 intro, #17 Cymatics, #33 visualizer/FPS, #34 eight-role evolution, #13 AIR, remaining issue requirements and software acceptance). Do not treat MIDI deferral as approval to waive unrelated failures.
- In issue #32's canonical requirement matrix, record two distinct entries `MIDI-USB` and `MIDI-BLE` with status **OWNER-AUTHORIZED DEFERRED**, exact comment source, rationale/dependency, follow-up trigger and carry-forward in `NEXT_BUILD_ACTIVE.md`. Revise release-gate expectations so the absent MIDI features are no longer release blockers **only** because this precise owner deferral is recorded. Targeted tests must still show no existing functionality regressed.
- The current Work session ran out of usage. **Do not start a competing build, modify the active checkout or erase the saved v0.6.6 development state**; on next Work resumption verify newest remote checkpoint and lock first, reuse `NEXT_RESUME.md` and existing tests, then finish remaining non-MIDI requirements, full software release acceptance, verified backups and installer publication if gates pass. Preserve published v0.6.5 and keep KIRA-9 untouched.

This is an explicit owner-authorized release scope revision, not a claim MIDI is completed or permanently canceled.

comments.body:
## Owner-authorized mid-release deferral — BOTH USB AND BLE MIDI — 2026-11-06

**Newest owner instruction overrides previous "USB MIDI remains required" comment.** BOTH `MIDI-USB` and `MIDI-BLE` in issue #31 are now **explicit OWNER-AUTHORIZED DEFERRALS** for the current AQUORA v0.6.6 candidate. Revisit after KIRA-9 has a good working firmware build and the owner reprioritizes. Full details: https://github.com/CodingSlapfu/AQUORA/issues/31#issuecomment-6702097918

Requirement matrix/gates: split the two transport features into distinct rows, annotate `owner_authorized_deferred` (not COMPLETED), retain original requirements and a compact carry-forward item. The release gate must no longer treat missing USB/BLE MIDI implementation, external clock, routing, radio or two-device interoperability as blockers **for this version only**. Preserve partial work at checkpoint and do not expose fake unfinished functionality. AIR, internal transport, and internal-tempo PLAY LED blinking still must work; only *external MIDI clock sync* for the LED is deferred. All non-MIDI scope, verification, backups, acceptance and publication gates remain mandatory.

The prior Work session reached its usage limit; avoid competing edits and re-testing unrelated accepted work. On resume check the latest branch head/lock and reconcile this scope update in `validation/NEXT_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_MATRIX.md`, `NEXT_BUILD_ACTIVE.md`, `NEXT_RESUME.md` and tests before continuing. Preserve v0.6.5 and KIRA-9.
